summary: Owned Taiyuan appointments for Wang Xianzhi (p082) convert 太元中 as conventional AD 376-396, and the Xie An death / honors cluster converts 及安薨 and 加安殊禮 to AD 385 from the Xiaowu annals (太元十年八月丁酉). Xiaowu's 陛下踐阼 is not AD 373: Jinshu 孝武帝紀 dates the accession to 咸安二年秋七月己未 (AD 372); 寧康元年 is only 改元. Empress Anxi's 立 is not AD 396: that year is her 太子妃 appointment, while 安帝紀 dates 立皇后王氏 to 隆安元年二月戊午 (AD 397), so the posthumous 以後父追贈 suite and claim-798 are later reception dated a year too early and must not feed Xianzhi's life dates. 先帝 as Jianwen's 咸安 reign (371-372) and the legendary 箕皓 comparanda are supported. Invented floruits are rejected: 郗曇 340-361, the first wife's 360-386 divorce span, the unnamed brother's 344-386 copy of Xianzhi's life, 靜之嗣 as exact 386 plus 位至義興太守 386-420 (a dynasty window), and 桓玄 398-404. p082's hint that he died inside the Taiyuan office era contradicts the same chapter's 未幾 / 俄而 sequel after 385. Year-only era labels were checked against Jinshu annals and era tables; no month/day Western dates were certified, and Academia Sinica's pre-1582 Julian default does not move these year-labels.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xianzhi was appointed General Who Establishes Might soon after the Taiyuan-era plaque episode.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p082 (王獻之). s0291 records 尋除建威將軍 immediately after the s0281 太元中 Taiyuan-Hall conversation. 太元 is Xiaowu of Eastern Jin's second era; conventional year labels are AD 376-396. The interval is uncertainty about when inside that era the appointment fell, not a dynasty-long activity span. Year-only era mapping; no month/day Western date is claimed.

evidence.quote: 尋除建威將軍、吳興太守

itemChecks.reason: Owner is p082. The same 尋除 clause names 吳興太守 under the 太元中 context already justified for claim-655. Endpoints AD 376 and 396 are the conventional first and last Taiyuan year-labels, not invented extra bounds.

evidence.quote: 尋除建威將軍、吳興太守

itemChecks.event: Wang Xianzhi was then summoned as Palace Secretary (中書令).

itemChecks.event: Wang Xianzhi was posted to Wuxing as its administrator.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p082. 吳興太守 in s0291 is the posting; the place-association is the same Taiyuan-contextual appointment as claim-656. Endpoints follow the 太元 year-labels 376-396.

itemChecks.event: Xie An died, which opened the court debate on his honors.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p095 (安 / Xie An). 及安薨 is his own death. Chapter 80 gives no year; Jinshu 孝武帝紀 places 太保謝安薨 on 太元十年八月丁酉. 太元十年 maps to conventional AD 385, and the eighth month is not a New Year edge, so the year-label 385 stands. This is a death date, not an activity span.

itemChecks.event: After the memorial, Emperor Xiaowu granted Xie An special burial honors.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p095 as the recipient of 殊禮. The grant is later reception of a dead minister, dated to Xiaowu's act, not reused as Xie An's living activity. The chapter places it directly after 及安薨; the annals still record the 太元十年 (AD 385) burial/enfeoffment sequence. Year 385 is the reception's own date.

itemChecks.event: The memorial recalls that Xie An was still in his prime when Xiaowu acceded.
itemChecks.reason: Owner of 踐阼 is Xiaowu, not Xie An; for p095 the dated fact is only that he was alive and serving at that accession. 陛下踐阼 is the accession act. Jinshu 孝武帝紀 dates it to 咸安二年秋七月己未, whose conventional year-label is AD 372. 寧康元年正月己丑朔，改元 is the following New Year era-change (AD 373), not the accession. Exact westernYear 373 therefore misconverts the event. Do not keep 373 as a second endpoint.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xianzhi joined Xu Miao in arguing Xie An's loyal service when An died.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p096 (獻之). This is his own living intervention at 及安薨. The death year of Xie An converts to AD 385 as in claim-793. The memorial in s0346 is the same sequel, not a later century quotation.

evidence.quote: 惟獻之、徐邈共明安之忠勳。

itemChecks.event: Wang Xianzhi fell ill not long after the Xie An honors episode.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p096. 未幾，獻之遇疾 follows 及安薨 (AD 385). 未幾 can still fall inside 385, so the closed interval 385-386 is the right one-sided-aware window (onOrAfter 385 through 386), not 'after 385' alone. The chapter's 俄而卒於官 keeps the illness in that short sequel; this is uncertainty about one event, not a career span.

itemChecks.event: After Xianzhi's death the installation of Empress Anxi triggered posthumous honors for her father.
itemChecks.reason: Owner of 安僖皇后立 is the empress (p104); for p096 this is later reception, not living attestation. The chapter dates the honors to 安僖皇后立, not to 太元二十一年. Jinshu 后妃傳 says she was made heir-consort in 太元二十一年 (conventional AD 396) and empress after An's accession; Jinshu 安帝紀 dates 立皇后王氏 to 隆安元年二月戊午, whose year-label is AD 397. Exact 396 therefore uses the heir-consort year and a life-attestation predicate for a retrospective grant. Keep the reception; redate it.

evidence.quote: 安僖皇后立，以後父追贈侍中、特進、光祿大夫、太宰，諡曰憲。

itemChecks.event: Xu Miao joined Wang Xianzhi in defending Xie An's honors when An died.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p097 (徐邈). The only dated act in this chapter is that joint argument at 及安薨. Xie An's death converts to AD 385. No wider career window is attached.

evidence.quote: 惟獻之、徐邈共明安之忠勳。

itemChecks.reason: Owner is p098. 契齊箕皓 is a rhetorical comparison, not a dated life event and not a twin inference. Qualitative 'legendary antiquity' invents no Western year and correctly refuses a guessed endpoint.

itemChecks.reason: Owner is p099. Same undated legendary comparandum as claim-800. Qualitative dating is the supported reading; no year should be added.

itemChecks.reason: Owner is p100, the unnamed 先帝 in a memorial addressed to 陛下 (Xiaowu). In that speech 先帝 is Xiaowu's predecessor, Emperor Jianwen, whose 咸安 era labels are AD 371-372. The interval is Jianwen's own short reign, the period in which 服事先帝 can fall, not a dynasty-long activity span and not Xiaowu's accession year.

itemChecks.event: Emperor Xiaowu acceded, which the memorial names as 陛下踐阼.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p101. 踐阼 is his own accession. Jinshu 孝武帝紀: 咸安二年秋七月己未 the heir '太子卽皇帝位'; 寧康元年 is only 改元. Conventional 咸安二年 = AD 372. Exact westernYear 373 dates the era-change, not the accession, and must not be kept as a substitute endpoint.

itemChecks.event: Emperor Xiaowu himself granted Xie An the special honors.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p101. 孝武帝遂加安殊禮 is Xiaowu's living act after 及安薨. The grant belongs in AD 385 with Xie An's death-year conversion, as reception dated to the grant, not as Xie An's life-date.

itemChecks.event: The chapter only identifies Xi Tan as father of Xianzhi's first wife and gives him no date.
itemChecks.reason: Owner would have to be p102 (郗曇), but s0294 is an undated kinship note. 郗曇 is not a source date. AD 340-361 is an imported career/life window the chapter does not support. A date window must describe uncertainty about a sourced event, not a biography filled in from elsewhere. Leave the name undated; do not keep 340-361.

itemChecks.event: On his deathbed Xianzhi recalled divorcing his first wife from the Xi family; the divorce itself is not dated.
itemChecks.reason: Owner of the confession is p096 at 遇疾; p103 (前妻) is only the wife named in that recollection. 與郗家離婚 is a past act without a year. AD 360-386 is a guessed adult-life span, not uncertainty about one sourced moment. The confession is sequential with 未幾遇疾 / 俄而卒 after 安薨 (385-386); that window dates the recollection, not the divorce, and must not be widened to 360.

itemChecks.event: Empress Anxi was installed, which the chapter uses to date her father's posthumous gifts.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p104. 安僖皇后立 is her installation as empress, not her 太元二十一年 appointment as heir-consort. Jinshu 安帝紀: 隆安元年二月戊午，立皇后王氏, conventional AD 397. Exact 396 collapses 即位 / 太子妃 into 立后 and creates false precision against the annal date.

itemChecks.event: The chapter mentions Xianzhi's elder brother only as the father of the adopted heir Jingzhi.
itemChecks.reason: Owner would be p105 (兄), but 以兄子靜之嗣 dates Jingzhi's adoption, not the brother's life. AD 344-386 copies Wang Xianzhi's conventional lifespan onto an unnamed sibling. No birth, death, or age for this brother appears in the owned units. Remove the invented endpoints; do not convert anyone else's traditional age into this man's dates.

itemChecks.event: Wang Jingzhi was adopted as Xianzhi's heir because Xianzhi had no son.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p106 (靜之). The succession is undated. Placing it as exact AD 386 turns the 385-386 death sequel into a false precise year and ignores that the sentence follows the later 安僖皇后立 honors. An unresolved source date needs unresolved:true, not a guessed single year.

itemChecks.event: Wang Jingzhi later reached the office of Administrator of Yixing.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p106. 位至義興太守 has no year. AD 386-420 is activity imagined from Xianzhi's death to the fall of Eastern Jin, which is a dynasty span, not uncertainty about one event. Do not invent the 420 endpoint.

itemChecks.event: Huan Xuan kept albums of Wang Xizhi's and Wang Xianzhi's calligraphy beside him.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p108. 桓玄雅愛其父子書 is his own undated appreciation and later reception of the Wangs' work. AD 398-404 is Huan Xuan's late political floruit, not a date in this passage. Do not turn an undated reception into a career window.

itemChecks.event: Xie An died (薨), which this chapter uses to open the honors debate.

itemChecks.reason: Owner is p096 as honorand; this is retrospective reception, not a living office. The grant is dated to 安僖皇后立. That installation is 隆安元年二月 (AD 397), not AD 396. Keep the posthumous honor; replace the year. Do not use 396 as an active hint.

itemChecks.reason: Owner is p096; retrospective grant of 特進 on 安僖皇后立. Same 396-versus-397 defect as claim-842. Year-label must follow 隆安元年, not the 太元二十一年 heir-consort year.

itemChecks.event: The same grant posthumously awarded Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p096; retrospective 光祿大夫 on 安僖皇后立. Exact AD 396 is the wrong Western year for the empress's installation.

itemChecks.reason: Owner is p096; retrospective 太宰 on 安僖皇后立. Same incorrect 396 conversion.

itemChecks.event: The same grant conferred the posthumous title Xian (憲).
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p096; 諡曰憲 is retrospective on 安僖皇后立. Date the reception to the empress-installation year AD 397, not 396, and do not read the honor as living activity.

itemChecks.event: Emperor Xiaowu acceded to the throne (陛下踐阼).
itemChecks.reason: Owner is p101. This is the accession itself. Primary annal: 咸安二年秋七月己未, 太子卽皇帝位 = conventional AD 372. westernYear 373 is 寧康改元, not 踐阼. No second endpoint should be invented to keep 373.

itemChecks.event: The hint pairs Wang Xianzhi's Taiyuan offices with a claim that he died inside that same 376-396 career window.
itemChecks.reason: Taiyuan offices (尋除 after 太元中) do support an AD 376-396 office hint. The second string, however, feeds death into that era span. Owned sequel 未幾遇疾 / 俄而卒於官 after 及安薨 belongs in 385-386; context claim-676's 376-396 death window is the same error. Later posthumous honors must stay out of activity. Split the office hint from death and do not reuse 太元中 as a death date.

evidence.quote: 尋除建威將軍、吳興太守，徵拜中書令。

itemChecks.event: The hint treats Xie An as active from Xiaowu's supposed AD 373 accession through his AD 385 death.
itemChecks.reason: Death in AD 385 is his own event (及安薨). The 373 start copies the false 踐阼 conversion; Xiaowu acceded in 咸安二年 / AD 372. AD 385 as an extra active hint also risks feeding the posthumous 殊禮 into living activity. Keep death separate; start any service hint from the accession year 372 or from sourced offices, not 373.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xianzhi's last living acts are the Xie An memorial and the illness that ended in his death.
itemChecks.reason: AD 385-386 matches 及安薨 plus 未幾遇疾 / 俄而卒於官 and does not import 安僖皇后立. The later posthumous offices are correctly kept off this active hint.

itemChecks.reason: The AD 385 hint is that one event (及安薨), not a career invented around his name.

itemChecks.reason: No Western year is offered. That matches 契齊箕皓 and does not invent a floruit.

itemChecks.event: The hint records Hao only as a legendary ancient comparandum, not a dated life event.
itemChecks.reason: Same qualitative restraint as p098; supported.

itemChecks.reason: AD 371-372 is the conventional 咸安 year-label pair for Xiaowu's 先帝, not a later quotation date and not Xiaowu's accession.

itemChecks.event: The hint dates Xiaowu's accession to AD 373 and his grant of Xie An's honors to AD 385.
itemChecks.reason: The 385 grant is Xiaowu's own act (孝武帝遂加安殊禮) and may stand. AD 373 is not 踐阼; accession is 咸安二年 / AD 372. Replace 373 with 372; do not leave both years as if they were competing equally sourced readings of the same act.

itemChecks.event: The hint assigns Xi Tan an AD 340-361 floruit that this chapter never states.
itemChecks.reason: s0294 only says Xianzhi's first wife was 郗曇女. The hint has no sourced personal event to date. Remove 340-361.

itemChecks.event: The hint dates the former wife's life or divorce to AD 360-386, which the chapter does not give.
itemChecks.reason: Her only appearance is the deathbed recollection 與郗家離婚. That is not a 26-year activity window. Do not turn the undated divorce into a career span.

itemChecks.event: The hint dates Empress Anxi's installation to AD 396.
itemChecks.reason: 安僖皇后立 is her own installation. The annal date is 隆安元年二月 / AD 397. 396 is when she was made heir-consort (太元二十一年納為太子妃), a different event. Replace the hint year.

itemChecks.event: The hint gives the unnamed elder brother an AD 344-386 life span copied from Wang Xianzhi.
itemChecks.reason: The brother has no own dated event. 以兄子靜之嗣 does not date his birth or death. Remove the hint years.

itemChecks.event: The hint dates Jingzhi's adoption to AD 386 and his Yixing office to AD 386-420.
itemChecks.reason: Neither 嗣 nor 位至義興太守 carries a year. Exact 386 and the 420 Jin-ending bound are invented. Mark both undated or use only a one-sided bound after Xianzhi's death, without a fabricated close.

evidence.quote: 無子，以兄子靜之嗣，位至義興太守。

itemChecks.event: The hint places Huan Xuan's fondness for the Wangs' calligraphy in AD 398-404.
itemChecks.reason: s0299 gives no year. 398-404 is his political rise-to-fall, not this appreciation. The hint lacks a sourced dated event and must drop the window.

evidence.quote: 桓玄雅愛其父子書，各為一帙，置左右以玩之。

personChecks.reason: Owned Taiyuan appointments (claims 655-657, 660) are coherent as 太元中 / 尋除 events inside AD 376-396. Context ages 年數歲 and 七八歲時 are unconverted, which is correct. Chronology breaks on death: context claim-676 and hints-p082 place death inside the same 376-396 office era, while the later owned narrative (s0292-s0295, p096) has 未幾遇疾 and 俄而卒於官 after 及安薨 (385-386). p082 and p096 are the same historical man split across IDs; the wide Taiyuan death window is not a supported personal event. No birth is stated in these units. Repair the death hint; do not certify the era span as his death.

evidence.quote: 尋除建威將軍、吳興太守，徵拜中書令。

personChecks.reason: Death 及安薨 and the 385 conversion are supported, and 殊禮 is a same-year retrospective grant. The person is not certifiable from those events alone because claim-795 / hints-p095 start his service at AD 373, which is Xiaowu's 寧康改元 rather than 踐阼 (372). Posthumous 殊禮 must not be reused as living activity. No birth or age appears in the owned memorial units.

Living sequence is coherent: argument at 及安薨 (385), 未幾遇疾, 俄而卒於官 (385-386). That death already rules out using 安僖皇后立 as a life attestation (claim-798). Claims 842-846 are legitimate retrospective honors but are dated 396 instead of the 隆安元年 / 397 installation. Hints-p096 correctly omit 396; the dated claims do not. No birth or age is given in these units. Keep reception as reception; fix the year; do not feed it back into activity.

安僖皇后立，以後父追贈侍中、特進、光祿大夫、太宰，諡曰憲。

personChecks.reason: Xu Miao appears only in the 及安薨 honors debate. That single AD 385 act is his own event; there is no omitted birth, death, or competing date in the owned units, and the hint matches the claim.

evidence.quote: 惟獻之、徐邈共明安之忠勳。

personChecks.reason: Ji is only a legendary comparandum in 契齊箕皓. No omitted calendar date, age, birth, or death is hiding in the owned units. Qualitative antiquity is the complete chronology the source allows.
Hao is the other legendary comparandum in the same clause. Same restraint as p098; no year should be researched into existence.

The unnamed 先帝, addressed beside 陛下踐阼, is Xiaowu's predecessor. 咸安 year-labels AD 371-372 date that ruler's own reign, which is the only interval 服事先帝 can occupy here. The text does not give a death month, and none was invented.

Xiaowu's own events in this chapter are 踐阼 and 加安殊禮. The honors grant in 385 is supported. Accession dated 373 (claims 803, 907 and the hint) contradicts the annal 咸安二年七月 accession (AD 372). 寧康元年 is 改元, not 踐阼. A person check cannot accept the 373 cluster as coherent chronology.

Xi Tan is named only as father of the first wife. No office, death, age, or year is present. Claim-805 and hints-p102 impose AD 340-361, which is not uncertainty about a sourced event. Context items do not repair this. Leave him undated in this chapter.

The former wife is identified (郗曇女) and recalled in the divorce confession. That confession belongs to Xianzhi's last illness (385-386); her marriage and divorce remain undated. AD 360-386 is an invented life span. Do not convert the deathbed recollection into her floruit.

Her own event is 安僖皇后立. Dating it AD 396 conflicts with 安帝紀 隆安元年二月立皇后王氏 (AD 397) and with 后妃傳, which assigns 太元二十一年 only to 納為太子妃. The person has no birth or death in these units; the one dated claim is the wrong year.

The elder brother is a kinship word in 兄子靜之嗣. No personal event, age, or date is supplied. AD 344-386 is Xianzhi's conventional life copied onto him. That is incoherent imported chronology, not a supported omission of a stated birth or death.

Jingzhi is adopted and later '位至義興太守'. Both facts are undated. Exact 386 and 386-420 treat succession as Xianzhi's death-year and the office as the rest of Eastern Jin. Chapter context does not give those endpoints. Mark unresolved rather than certifying a dynasty window.

evidence.quote: 無子，以兄子靜之嗣，位至義興太守。

personChecks.reason: Huan Xuan's only act here is undated appreciation of the two Wangs' writing, a later reception of their work. AD 398-404 is not in the passage. No birth or death is omitted from these units; the defect is a fabricated floruit used as an active hint.

evidence.quote: 桓玄雅愛其父子書，各為一帙，置左右以玩之。

findings.problem: 陛下踐阼 is Xiaowu's accession in 咸安二年秋七月己未 (conventional AD 372). The extraction uses exact AD 373, which is 寧康元年改元, and then starts Xie An's active hint at that false year.
findings.action: Replace the accession westernYear with AD 372 on claim-803, claim-907, and the Xie An contextual attestation claim-795. Synchronize hints-p101 and the start of hints-p095 to 372. Do not keep 373 as a second endpoint or treat 寧康 as the accession date.

findings.problem: 安僖皇后立 is the empress's installation. 安帝紀 dates 立皇后王氏 to 隆安元年二月戊午 (AD 397). 太元二十一年 / AD 396 is when she was made heir-consort. Claim-798 also treats that later reception as Xianzhi's living attestation after 俄而卒於官.
findings.action: Redate claim-807 and the posthumous honors claim-842 through claim-846 to AD 397 as retrospective reception on 安僖皇后立. Reclassify or replace claim-798 so 396/397 is the reception date, not a life attestation, and keep it off p096 active hints. Set hints-p104 to 397. Do not discard the honors.

findings.problem: 郗曇 is an undated kinship identification. AD 340-361 is not in the chapter.
findings.action: Remove the 340-361 interval from claim-805 and hints-p102, or mark the attestation unresolved with a reason that the chapter gives no date. Do not import a full Xi Tan biography.

findings.problem: 與郗家離婚 is recalled at Xianzhi's last illness; the divorce year is not stated. AD 360-386 is a guessed life span.
findings.action: Drop 360-386. If a date is kept, date only the deathbed recollection with the 385-386 illness/death sequel, and leave the divorce itself unresolved.

findings.problem: 兄 in 以兄子靜之嗣 has no own dated event. AD 344-386 copies Xianzhi's conventional life onto the brother.
findings.action: Remove the invented endpoints and the active hint years. Do not infer a birth year from anyone's traditional inclusive age.

findings.problem: 靜之嗣 and 位至義興太守 are undated. Exact 386 is false precision; 386-420 is activity through the end of Eastern Jin.
findings.action: Mark both claims unresolved, or use only a one-sided bound after Xianzhi's death (onOrAfter 385/386) without inventing 420. Clear the matching hints.

findings.problem: 桓玄雅愛其父子書 is undated later reception. AD 398-404 is Huan Xuan's political floruit, not this passage.
findings.action: Remove the 398-404 window and the active hint. Keep the appreciation as an undated or retrospective event; do not fabricate a career interval.

findings.problem: p082's death is fed into the Taiyuan office window AD 376-396, against the same chapter's 未幾 / 俄而 sequel after Xie An's AD 385 death.
findings.action: Keep the 376-396 hint only for the 太元中 / 尋除 offices. Date illness and death from 及安薨 plus 未幾遇疾 / 俄而卒於官 (385-386), in line with p096, and do not use the posthumous 396/397 honors as life dates.

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀
references.quote: 咸安二年秋七月己未，立為皇太子。是日，簡文帝崩，太子卽皇帝位。
references.reason: Primary annal for 陛下踐阼: Xiaowu acceded on the day Jianwen died in 咸安二年七月, not in 寧康元年.

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀
references.quote: 寧康元年春正月己丑朔，改元。
references.reason: Shows AD 373 is the Ningkang era-change, which must not be substituted for the 咸安二年 accession.

references.title: 晉書/卷009 孝武帝紀
references.quote: 丁酉，使持節、侍中、中書監、大都督十五州諸軍事、衛將軍、太保謝安薨。
references.reason: Primary annal, under 太元十年八月, for converting 及安薨 to conventional AD 385.

references.title: 太元 (东晋)
references.quote: 太元（ 376年—396年）是東晋皇帝晋孝武帝司马曜的第二个年号
references.reason: Calendar reference for mapping 太元中 and 太元十年 to conventional AD 376-396 / 385 year-labels (ruler Xiaowu, Eastern Jin).

references.title: 太元 (东晋)
references.quote: 太元二十二年（397年）正月一日，改元為隆安元年。
references.reason: Calendar reference that 隆安元年, the year of 立皇后王氏, is conventional AD 397, not 396.

references.title: 咸安 (年号)
references.quote: 咸安（ 371年十一月—372年）是東晋皇帝晉简文帝司馬昱的年号
references.reason: Calendar reference for Jianwen's 咸安 reign-labels used for 先帝 and for converting 咸安二年七月 to AD 372.

references.title: 晉書/卷010 安帝紀
references.reason: Primary annal, under 隆安元年二月, for 安僖皇后立. This is the empress installation, distinct from the 太元二十一年 heir-consort appointment.

references.title: 晉書/卷032 安僖王皇后傳
references.quote: 后以太元二十一年納為太子妃。及安帝即位，立為皇后。
references.reason: Explains the competing 396 reading: Taiyuan 21 is 納為太子妃; 立為皇后 is a later clause, which the annals date to Long'an 1.
